Fear Free Pet Cat Care For You, Your Family, Your Vet and Your Feline Friend
Your pet cat's health problems can become your problems very quickly.   Feline Friendly is a considered approach that takes your cat's medical and emotional wellbeing into account from kitten to elderly cat status!  

Follow Dr. Kim Kendall, BVSc at www.felinefriendlycare.com as she outlines the long term changes you as an owner, or veterinarian can make to a cat's health just by the basic measures you take as an owner.  

And there is plenty for the veterinary professionals too, who often aren't aware of the basic fundamental and 'minimal intrusion' techniques they can apply to enhance the cat's wellbeing at the clinic and at home.

A happy cat is a happy veterinary practice too :)

This channel isn't just for owners looking for the best way to care for their 'Fluffy' .  It also provides important videos on topics such as cat acupuncture, feline diabetes, and cat dental health.
